row.notes: Read in full: (zone, point*) n1 = normalize(+0x60), d1 = +0x6c; axis = normalize(+0xd0 - +0xc0). If axis is parallel to n1 returns plane distance -(dot(n1,p)-d1); else same test with n2 (+0x70, d +0x7c); else intersects the axis line through p with both planes and returns the parameter t = dot(p-a, b-a)/|b-a|^2; result clamped to [0,1] and mapped as t*[+0x138] + [+0x134]. So a remapped 0..1 position between two planes, not a raw signed distance. (lane owner review requested)
